metadata.goal: Read a YAML config file and produce a validation report — checking for required fields, type mismatches, and deprecated keys — written to output/ as a markdown file
metadata.platform_note: Tier 2 (Cursor/Windsurf/Cline): no agent files; all steps execute inline in the entry skill's session. dispatch_mechanism is inline. model is inherit — host IDE owns model selection. No Task() primitive. Reviewer isolation is convention-only.
degradation_warnings: Reviewer isolation impossible on this platform: writer and reviewer are the same agent in the same context. Review steps execute the reviewer protocol but cannot provide assumption-blindness defense or context-bleed isolation. Treat review output as a self-check, not verification.
Parallel fan-out (Pattern 2) requires worktrees and is unavailable on this platform (worktrees: false).
Model selection is owned by the host IDE; per-step model assignment is not emitted.

steps.description: Reads the input YAML config file, parses it, checks for required fields, type mismatches, and deprecated keys, writes validator-findings.json to the temp directory. Executes inline in the entry skill's session.

Reviews validator-findings.json for false positives by re-deriving findings from the raw YAML input (convention-only isolation, C19 self-skepticism preamble). Writes reviewed-findings.json to the temp directory. Executes inline in the entry skill's session.

Reads reviewed-findings.json from the temp directory, formats a structured markdown validation report with sections for required-field violations, type mismatches, deprecated keys, and dismissed findings, writes parity-test-h-validation-report.md to output/. Executes inline in the entry skill's session.
